tasks.gr7-listening-speaking-t4: Topic: Listening and Speaking (Grade 7 Term 4). Cover health, feelings, future plans, revision talks, and discussion skills. Ask learners to choose appropriate vocabulary for wellbeing topics, identify strong prepared-talk structure, respond politely in group discussion, and interpret short listening prompts accurately.
tasks.gr7-reading-viewing-t4: Topic: Reading and Viewing (Grade 7 Term 4). Cover revision passages, comprehension texts, notices, stories, and short summaries. Ask learners to select key information, answer retrieval and inference questions, match notices to purpose, and choose the best summary points from short texts.
tasks.gr7-writing-presenting-t4: Topic: Writing and Presenting (Grade 7 Term 4). Cover personal recounts, short reviews, message writing, and revision paragraphs. Ask learners to choose suitable format and tone, organise supporting details, identify effective openings and conclusions, and edit writing for grammar, spelling, and punctuation.
tasks.gr7-language-structures-t4: Topic: Language Structures (Grade 7 Term 4). Revise tenses, pronouns, question forms, concords, and spelling. Ask learners to complete mixed grammar MCQs, correct sentence errors, identify accurate spelling and punctuation, and consolidate language control for end-of-year assessment readiness.
